author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: I can live with a manual consent check for the next few promotion cycles. Right now, the pipeline stability depends on me stepping in to verify the data contracts before they hit the production cluster. If we automate the governance layer immediately, I risk breaking the nightly forecast job during the transition. I am willing to accept the extra administrative load of reviewing each loyalty batch by hand. That trade keeps the deployment reliable while we build the automated enforcement. Once the new contract validation tooling is stable, I will drop the manual step entirely, but I need that buffer to avoid a silent failure during the weekly leaflet planning window.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly accepts the burden of manual consent checks to preserve pipeline stability, framing it as a temporary compromise to avoid breaking the nightly forecast job during the transition to automated governance.
